messages:
Maya: Kicking off deploy window for model-serving change — flipping feature flag dynamic-kv-split in soft-toggle mode. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Will ramp cohorts: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with ~10m soak each stage.
Sam: ack. rolling canary + pinned version model:v3.1.2 on blue pool. If p95 latency > +40ms or error-rate > 1.5% rollback immediately.
liam: any telemetry dashboards to watch? I'll wire up a quick panel.
Maya: watching p95, tok/s, and kv-cache-hit-rate. Release note draft: 'optimize kv split to reduce memory pressure' — small perf test on staging looked OK.
deploy-bot: scheduled toggle dynamic-kv-split -> 0.5% at 1763141640
ops-ivan: suggest adding a slow-path kill switch: toggle dynamic-kv-split=false for all traffic if regen latency > 80ms for 3 consecutive mins.
Sam: agreed. I'll pin routing to model:v3.1.2 and keep fallback to v3.0.8 for 10m after each stage.
Maya: Sam, please trigger the stage manually if metrics look green. We'll do first stage now.
deploy-bot: executed: dynamic-kv-split=0.5% cohorts=[soak]; note: target_nodes=15
liam: p95 +5ms, error-rate 0.2%, kv-hit stable. :thumbsup:
Maya: proceed to 5% in 8m unless anything spikes.
deploy-bot: manual request received to advance to 5% by Sam at 1763141690
Sam: advancing.
deploy-bot: executed: dynamic-kv-split=5% cohorts=[soak,beta]
ops-ivan: quick reminder — if any SLO breach, run `deploy-bot rollback dynamic-kv-split` and open incident channel.
Maya: release-note-bot, add blurb 'kv-split: gradual rollout to reduce mem pressure; rollback criteria: p95 +40ms or errors >1.5%.'
release-note-bot: added to changelog under 2024-06-08 deploys
Sam: monitoring 10m window now. planning 25% after green.
Maya: thumbs if ok to pin for next 24h on dedicated pools.
liam: :thumbsup:
Maya: final note — don't forget to unpin if we see eviction spikes. tagging @oncall for visibility.
ops-ivan: oncall acknowledged.
